schema: CREATE TABLE VISITS (VISIT_ID INT, CUSTOMER_ID INT, PRIMARY KEY (VISIT_ID));
CREATE TABLE TRANSACTIONS (TRANSACTION_ID INT, VISIT_ID int, AMOUNT INT, PRIMARY KEY (TRANSACTION_ID), FOREIGN KEY (VISIT_ID) REFERENCES VISITS(VISIT_ID));
correct_query: SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(*) AS COUNT_NO_TRANS FROM VISITS WHERE VISIT_ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT VISIT_ID FROM TRANSACTIONS) GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
